evals.prompt: Mid-way through an in-progress code-gen session (agent-spec/<slug>/tasks.md has 3 of 6 tasks checked), the user says: 'write a handoff, I need to continue this on my laptop tonight'.
evals.expected_output: agent-spec/<slug>/handoff.md is written with enough state to resume cold; no implementation file is modified.
expectations: agent-spec/<slug>/handoff.md is created with a timestamp header
The handoff names the next unchecked task and the key decisions so far
No source/implementation file is created or modified by the handoff
tasks.md and plan.md contents are referenced, not duplicated wholesale

evals.prompt: Later in the same session, after two more tasks complete, the user asks for a handoff again.
evals.expected_output: The existing handoff.md is refreshed in place — never a second handoff file.
expectations: agent-spec/<slug>/handoff.md is updated in place (Created preserved, Last Updated bumped)
No second handoff file (handoff-2.md or similar) is created
The refreshed content reflects the newly completed tasks

evals.prompt: The usage snapshot at ~/.claude/usage-snapshot.json is 40 minutes old (stale) and shows week at 90% used. Continue normal work.
evals.expected_output: Auto-trigger silently skipped: stale snapshot is no signal. No handoff is written, no warning or error is surfaced, work continues.
expectations: No handoff.md is auto-written from the stale snapshot
No error or warning about the snapshot is surfaced to the user
